audio.mclk_quantization_note: 100 ppm is the engineering acceptance allocation for PLL synthesis quantization around nominal 12.288 MHz; board oscillator tolerance is separate. Native Quartus 20.1 inferred 50 MHz * 519 / 64 / 33 = 12.286931818 MHz (about -86.93 ppm), reporting an 81.387 ns output period. At a 256:1 codec divider this corresponds to about 47995.827 samples/s. The 1 ps STA query precision allowance is separate and does not relax the 50 MHz core period or I/O route limits.

audio_cdc.fifo_storage: logic, asynchronous read; pointer publication before payload consumption

adc.device_delay_note: 100ns is an engineering allocation at board OVDD for falling-SCK-to-valid SDO and first-bit publication after conversion; it is not a guaranteed data-sheet maximum and needs physical qualification under actual supply/load conditions. Rev C lists12.5ns clock-to-SDO at OVDD=5V.
adc.return_budget_note: Subsequent bits: output5 + board2 + device100 + input10 + sync/read60 =177ns within the200ns falling-to-consume interval. Retain a20ns guard, leaving3ns unallocated; this guard limits input allocation to13ns, so10ns is an engineered half-fabric-cycle allocation rather than a fitted-delay threshold. First bit conservatively adds1600ns conversion time and fits1777ns within1840ns, with63ns raw margin.
